fields.primary_unique_math: The exact independent hinge-fold audit primary_fold_audit.json propagates all five square faces and all four quarter triangles for every net. Nets1,2,4 cover the missing face with four distinct quarters sharing its center. In net3 the upper and lower triangles fold onto occupied square faces; in net5 one triangle folds onto an occupied square. Thus invalid nets3and5 uniquely giveE. C and D repeat2and4 in the unchanged formal source but both are incorrect. Coloring existing cut sides creates no new cut, tab, hinge, triangle or face; geometry of each triangular quarter remains visible.
